docs.description: Checked or not. A new state from the server wins (send checked="false" to clear it); the live state is the checked property.

Visible label next to the box, and its accessible name.
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command), and the field it submits in a form.
What a form submits under name while checked, like a native checkbox.
